instruction: A candid full shot of three friends playing a game in a grassy park under soft daylight. On the left, the bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R2) stands in profile, facing right. In the center, the smiling woman in a dark blue t-shirt with a red letter E (R4) stands facing forward. On the right, the laughing woman with an afro in a red t-shirt with a pink letter A (R6) faces left with her hands raised. They interact playfully in a semi-circle on the green lawn, with trees softly blurred in the background.
elements: R6 is the laughing participant with her hands raised toward the group during the playful game
R2 stands in profile facing toward the other participants rather than raising his hands
R4 is the smiling forward-facing participant in the middle of the playful semi-circle
R2, R4, and R6 interact playfully as friends in a semi-circle
The interaction takes place on a grassy park lawn
